title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
abstract: arXiv:2606.07001v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-quality training data is essential to large language models (LLMs) and typically requires extensive and costly manual curation. Automatic data preparation systems support reusable operators and task-driven workflows, yet adapting these workflows to the desired data quality remains challenging. High-quality examples provide a practical specification for guiding this adaptation. We introduce DataEvolver, a data preparation system that automatically constructs pipelines through multi-level self-evolution. At the operator level, it expands the operator library and refines logical plans to resolve dependency conflicts. At the pipeline level, it instantiates these plans into code and uses trial-output feedback to refine the pipeline toward seed-specified quality requirements. translated_title: DataEvolver：通过多层级自我进化实现大语言模型的自动化数据准备
translated_abstract: 高质量的训练数据对大语言模型（LLM）至关重要，且通常需要大量且成本高昂的人工整理。自动化数据准备系统支持可复用的算子和任务驱动的工作流，然而将这些工作流调整至期望的数据质量仍然具有挑战性。高质量示例为引导这种调整提供了实用的规范。我们提出DataEvolver，一个通过多层级自我进化自动构建数据管道的数据准备系统。在算子层面，它扩展算子库并优化逻辑计划以解决依赖冲突；在管道层面，它将这些计划实例化为代码，并利用试运行输出的反馈来改进管道，使其朝向种子示例所指定的质量要求演进。在七个基准上的实验表明，DataEvolver显著提升了数据质量，并取得了平均约10分的提升。
tldr: 提出DataEvolver系统，通过算子层与管道层的多层级自我进化自动构建并迭代优化数据准备管道，使其满足种子示例指定的质量要求，在七个基准上平均提升约10分的数据质量。
en_tdlr: DataEvolver automatically constructs and iteratively refines data preparation pipelines through multi-level self-evolution (operator-level and pipeline-level), guided by seed-specified quality requirements, substantially improving data quality with an average gain of about 10 points across seven benchmarks.
